matrix_name.name: epoxidized magnolol/diallyl disulfide crosslinked network
matrix_name.description: Control sample DGEM/DADS/(3SH)4/(4SH)6 prepared by photo-induced thiol-ene click reaction using epoxidized magnolol monomer (DGEM) and diallyl disulfide (DADS), cured with trimethylolpropane tris(3-mercaptopropionate) and pentaerythritol tetrakis(3-mercaptopropionate) at a 3SH:4SH molar ratio of 0.4:0.6; no 1-octadecanethiol grafting.
